summary: Announces the formation of the Network Data Management Committee, chaired by Doug McKay of IBM, after the data discussions at the May meeting. Its aims, from RFC 146, are to classify issues, integrate separate activities, and coordinate experiments.

eli5.summary: A new club to work out how computers should share information, with a leader, and a list of what the club hopes to do.
